---
title: "physio_eccentricity_dispersion_models"
output: html_document
---

This script tests whether physiological and subjective stress markers are associated with changes in brain eccentricity and dispersion between rest2 and rest3. The baseline-adjusted delta ANCOVAs are treated as the primary inferential models and are the only models entering the multiple-comparison correction procedure. In these ANCOVAs, the change-score outcome is modeled together with the baseline value of the same outcome as an intentional baseline-conditional change parameterization to reduce regression-to-the-mean artefacts; this estimand is a baseline-adjusted association with change rather than an unadjusted raw-difference effect. Correction is reported transparently across the same construct families as before: delta-ANCOVA model-level p-values are corrected within the eccentricity family and within the dispersion family, with an additional global BH correction across both families combined. Three-way random-intercept LMMs with participant-level stress-reactivity predictors are retained separately as lower-power, uncorrected sensitivity analyses and are excluded from all correction pools. Two-way LMMs are no longer part of the primary results summary or correction workflow. The script applies predefined participant and data-point exclusions, performs model diagnostics and sensitivity analyses, and summarizes primary ANCOVA results together with supplementary three-way LMM robustness checks.

## Prepare base outcome datasets and exclusion rules

```{r}
standardize_scan <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_match(
    x,
    "rs_2" ~ "rest2",
    "rs_3" ~ "rest3",
    "rest2" ~ "rest2",
    "rest3" ~ "rest3",
    "2" ~ "rest2",
    "3" ~ "rest3",
    .default = x
  )
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_log_pos <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x) | x <= 0, NA_real_, log(x))
}

z_num <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(scale(x))
}

# Exclusions aligned to Uhlig et al 2023 analysis
id_exclude_all <- "NECOS049"
id_exclude_endo <- c("NECOS049", "NECOS054")

eccentricity_base <- eccentricity %>%
  rename(Group = stress, MFD = headmotion) %>%
  mutate(
    NECOS_ID = as.character(NECOS_ID),
    Group = factor(Group),
    scan = standardize_scan(scan),
    scan = factor(scan, levels = c("rest2", "rest3")),
    log_MFD_scaled = z_num(safe_log_pos(MFD))
  ) %>%
  filter(scan %in% c("rest2", "rest3")) %>%
  filter(!NECOS_ID %in% id_exclude_all)

dispersion_base <- dispersion %>%
  rename(Group = stress, MFD = headmotion) %>%
  mutate(
    NECOS_ID = as.character(NECOS_ID),
    Group = factor(Group),
    scan = standardize_scan(scan),
    scan = factor(scan, levels = c("rest2", "rest3"))
  ) %>%
  filter(scan %in% c("rest2", "rest3")) %>%
  filter(!NECOS_ID %in% id_exclude_all)

ecc_dv_cols <- c("parcel_100", "parcel_377")
missing_ecc_dvs <- setdiff(ecc_dv_cols, names(eccentricity_base))
if (length(missing_ecc_dvs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing eccentricity DV columns: ", paste(missing_ecc_dvs, collapse = ", "))
}

disp_dv_cols <- c("distance_default_salience", "distance_control_salience")
missing_disp_dvs <- setdiff(disp_dv_cols, names(dispersion_base))
if (length(missing_disp_dvs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing dispersion DV columns: ", paste(missing_disp_dvs, collapse = ", "))
}

dispersion_base <- dispersion_base %>%
  group_by(NECOS_ID, Group, scan) %>%
  summarise(
    MFD = safe_mean(MFD),
    across(all_of(disp_dv_cols), safe_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_MFD_scaled = z_num(safe_log_pos(MFD))
  )

# Sensitivity exclusions are defined at the predictor level, not the outcome-family level.
# For example, NECOS042 is treated as an influential STAI/VAS delta case regardless of
# whether the dependent variable is eccentricity or dispersion based on analysis by Uhlig et al. 2023.
delta_sensitivity_exclude <- list(
  HR_delta = c("NECOS041", "NECOS055"),
  HRV_delta = character(0),
  SaCort_delta = character(0),
  asinh_ACTH_delta = character(0),
  STAI_delta = c("NECOS042"),
  VAS_delta = c("NECOS042")
)

pc_write_csv(eccentricity_base, file.path(tables_dir, "peripheral_eccentricity_base.csv"))
pc_write_csv(dispersion_base, file.path(tables_dir, "peripheral_dispersion_base.csv"))
```

# ANALYSIS

## Build eccentricity delta outcome dataset

```{r}
make_delta_data <- function(df, dv_cols, id_col = "NECOS_ID", group_col = "Group",
                            scan_col = "scan", motion_col = "MFD") {
  rest2 <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[scan_col]] == "rest2") %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_col, group_col, motion_col, dv_cols))) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_rest2"), all_of(c(motion_col, dv_cols)))

  rest3 <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[scan_col]] == "rest3") %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_col, group_col, motion_col, dv_cols))) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_rest3"), all_of(c(motion_col, dv_cols)))

  out <- rest2 %>%
    inner_join(rest3, by = c(id_col, group_col))

  for (dv in dv_cols) {
    out[[paste0("delta_", dv)]] <- out[[paste0(dv, "_rest3")]] - out[[paste0(dv, "_rest2")]]
  }

  out$mean_MFD <- rowMeans(
    cbind(out[[paste0(motion_col, "_rest2")]], out[[paste0(motion_col, "_rest3")]]),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  out$log_mean_MFD_scaled <- z_num(safe_log_pos(out$mean_MFD))

  out
}

ecc_delta_base <- make_delta_data(
  df = eccentricity_base,
  dv_cols = ecc_dv_cols,
  id_col = "NECOS_ID",
  group_col = "Group",
  scan_col = "scan",
  motion_col = "MFD"
)

pc_write_csv(ecc_delta_base, file.path(tables_dir, "peripheral_eccentricity_delta_base.csv"))
```

## Run eccentricity delta ANCOVAs

```{r}
sanitize_stub <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", ., perl = TRUE) %>%
    gsub("_+", "_", ., perl = TRUE)
}

write_output_metadata <- function(path, description, columns = NULL) {
  meta_path <- sub("\\.csv$", ".json", path)
  payload <- list(
    file = basename(path),
    description = description,
    columns = columns
  )
  jsonlite::write_json(payload, meta_path, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null")
}

prepare_lm_data <- function(df, dv, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col = NULL) {
  dv_rest2_col <- paste0(sub("^delta_", "", dv), "_rest2")
  cols <- c("NECOS_ID", "Group", "log_mean_MFD_scaled", predictor_delta_col, dv, dv_rest2_col)
  if (!is.null(predictor_baseline_col)) cols <- c(cols, predictor_baseline_col)

  df %>%
    select(any_of(cols)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    mutate(Group = droplevels(Group))
}

count_complete_cases_lm <- function(df, dv, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col = NULL) {
  dv_rest2_col <- paste0(sub("^delta_", "", dv), "_rest2")
  cols <- c("NECOS_ID", "Group", "log_mean_MFD_scaled", predictor_delta_col, dv, dv_rest2_col)
  if (!is.null(predictor_baseline_col)) cols <- c(cols, predictor_baseline_col)

  dat <- df %>%
    select(any_of(cols)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  tibble(
    DV = dv,
    predictor = predictor_delta_col,
    baseline = ifelse(is.null(predictor_baseline_col), NA_character_, predictor_baseline_col),
    n_complete_rows = nrow(dat),
    n_complete_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(dat$NECOS_ID)
  )
}

extract_vif_table <- function(vif_obj, dv, predictor_label, outcome_family) {
  if (is.null(vif_obj)) {
    return(tibble(
      DV = dv,
      predictor = predictor_label,
      outcome_family = outcome_family,
      term = NA_character_,
      vif = NA_real_,
      gvif_adj = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  if (is.matrix(vif_obj) || is.data.frame(vif_obj)) {
    out <- as.data.frame(vif_obj)
    out$term <- rownames(out)
    rownames(out) <- NULL

    if ("GVIF" %in% names(out) && "Df" %in% names(out)) {
      out <- out %>%
        transmute(
          DV = dv,
          predictor = predictor_label,
          outcome_family = outcome_family,
          term = term,
          vif = GVIF,
          gvif_adj = GVIF^(1 / (2 * Df))
        )
    } else if ("GVIF^(1/(2*Df))" %in% names(out)) {
      out <- out %>%
        transmute(
          DV = dv,
          predictor = predictor_label,
          outcome_family = outcome_family,
          term = term,
          vif = if ("VIF" %in% names(out)) VIF else NA_real_,
          gvif_adj = `GVIF^(1/(2*Df))`
        )
    } else {
      out <- out %>%
        transmute(
          DV = dv,
          predictor = predictor_label,
          outcome_family = outcome_family,
          term = term,
          vif = NA_real_,
          gvif_adj = NA_real_
        )
    }
  } else {
    out <- tibble(
      DV = dv,
      predictor = predictor_label,
      outcome_family = outcome_family,
      term = names(vif_obj),
      vif = as.numeric(vif_obj),
      gvif_adj = as.numeric(vif_obj)
    )
  }

  out
}

fit_lm_delta_set <- function(df, delta_dv_cols, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col = NULL) {
  fit_one <- purrr::safely(function(dv) {
    dat <- prepare_lm_data(df, dv, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col)
    dv_rest2_col <- paste0(sub("^delta_", "", dv), "_rest2")

    if (nrow(dat) < 20) {
      stop("Insufficient complete data for LM")
    }

    baseline_part <- paste0(" + ", dv_rest2_col)
    predictor_baseline_part <- if (!is.null(predictor_baseline_col)) paste0(" + ", predictor_baseline_col) else ""

    stats::lm(
      as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group * ", predictor_delta_col, baseline_part, predictor_baseline_part, " + log_mean_MFD_scaled")),
      data = dat
    )
  }, otherwise = NULL)

  fit_out <- map(delta_dv_cols, fit_one)
  models <- purrr::map(fit_out, "result")
  errors <- purrr::map_chr(fit_out, ~ if (is.null(.x$error)) NA_character_ else conditionMessage(.x$error))
  names(models) <- delta_dv_cols
  names(errors) <- delta_dv_cols

  list(models = models, errors = errors)
}

extract_lm_term <- function(models, fit_errors, term_label_model, term_label_report, predictor_label, baseline_label = NULL, outcome_family, analysis_label, file_stub) {
  map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
    mod <- models[[nm]]
    fit_error <- fit_errors[[nm]]

    if (is.null(mod)) {
      return(tibble(
        DV = nm,
        term = term_label_report,
        predictor = predictor_label,
        baseline = ifelse(is.null(baseline_label), NA_character_, baseline_label),
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        model_bundle = paste0(file_stub, "__", predictor_label),
        n = NA_integer_,
        convergence = fit_error,
        test = "type3_anova",
        f_value = NA_real_,
        num_df = NA_real_,
        den_df = NA_real_,
        eta2_partial = NA_real_,
        r2 = NA_real_,
        adj_r2 = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    an <- tryCatch(car::Anova(mod, type = 3), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(an) || !(term_label_model %in% rownames(an))) {
      return(tibble(
        DV = nm,
        term = term_label_report,
        predictor = predictor_label,
        baseline = ifelse(is.null(baseline_label), NA_character_, baseline_label),
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        model_bundle = paste0(file_stub, "__", predictor_label),
        n = stats::nobs(mod),
        convergence = ifelse(is.na(fit_error), "OK", fit_error),
        test = "type3_anova",
        f_value = NA_real_,
        num_df = NA_real_,
        den_df = NA_real_,
        eta2_partial = NA_real_,
        r2 = summary(mod)$r.squared,
        adj_r2 = summary(mod)$adj.r.squared,
        p = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    f_value <- as.numeric(an[term_label_model, "F value"])
    num_df <- as.numeric(an[term_label_model, "Df"])
    den_df <- stats::df.residual(mod)
    p_value <- as.numeric(an[term_label_model, "Pr(>F)"])
    eta2_partial <- if (is.finite(f_value) && is.finite(num_df) && is.finite(den_df)) {
      (f_value * num_df) / ((f_value * num_df) + den_df)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    tibble(
      DV = nm,
      term = term_label_report,
      predictor = predictor_label,
      baseline = ifelse(is.null(baseline_label), NA_character_, baseline_label),
      outcome_family = outcome_family,
      analysis = analysis_label,
      model_bundle = paste0(file_stub, "__", predictor_label),
      n = stats::nobs(mod),
      convergence = ifelse(is.na(fit_error), "OK", fit_error),
      test = "type3_anova",
      f_value = f_value,
      num_df = num_df,
      den_df = den_df,
      eta2_partial = eta2_partial,
      r2 = summary(mod)$r.squared,
      adj_r2 = summary(mod)$adj.r.squared,
      p = p_value
    )
  })
}

extract_lm_vif <- function(df, dv_cols, predictor_col, predictor_baseline_col = NULL, outcome_family) {
  map_df(dv_cols, function(dv) {
    dat <- prepare_lm_data(df, dv, predictor_col, predictor_baseline_col)
    dv_rest2_col <- paste0(sub("^delta_", "", dv), "_rest2")
    if (nrow(dat) < 20) {
      return(extract_vif_table(NULL, dv, predictor_col, outcome_family))
    }

    predictor_baseline_part <- if (!is.null(predictor_baseline_col)) paste0(" + ", predictor_baseline_col) else ""
    lm_proxy <- tryCatch(
      stats::lm(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group * ", predictor_col, " + ", dv_rest2_col, predictor_baseline_part, " + log_mean_MFD_scaled")), data = dat),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    vif_obj <- tryCatch(car::vif(lm_proxy, type = "predictor"), error = function(e) NULL)
    extract_vif_table(vif_obj, dv, predictor_col, outcome_family)
  })
}

extract_lm_influence_summary <- function(models, predictor_label, outcome_family, analysis_label) {
  map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
    mod <- models[[nm]]

    if (is.null(mod)) {
      return(tibble(
        DV = nm,
        predictor = predictor_label,
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        n = NA_integer_,
        max_cooks_d = NA_real_,
        mean_cooks_d = NA_real_,
        n_cooks_gt_4_over_n = NA_integer_,
        max_hat = NA_real_,
        max_abs_rstudent = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    infl <- tryCatch(influence.measures(mod), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(infl)) {
      return(tibble(
        DV = nm,
        predictor = predictor_label,
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        n = stats::nobs(mod),
        max_cooks_d = NA_real_,
        mean_cooks_d = NA_real_,
        n_cooks_gt_4_over_n = NA_integer_,
        max_hat = NA_real_,
        max_abs_rstudent = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    infmat <- infl$infmat
    cooks_vals <- if ("cook.d" %in% colnames(infmat)) infmat[, "cook.d"] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(infmat))
    hat_vals <- if ("hat" %in% colnames(infmat)) infmat[, "hat"] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(infmat))
    rstudent_vals <- tryCatch(rstudent(mod), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, stats::nobs(mod)))

    tibble(
      DV = nm,
      predictor = predictor_label,
      outcome_family = outcome_family,
      analysis = analysis_label,
      n = stats::nobs(mod),
      max_cooks_d = suppressWarnings(max(cooks_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mean_cooks_d = suppressWarnings(mean(cooks_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      n_cooks_gt_4_over_n = sum(cooks_vals > (4 / stats::nobs(mod)), na.rm = TRUE),
      max_hat = suppressWarnings(max(hat_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      max_abs_rstudent = suppressWarnings(max(abs(rstudent_vals), na.rm = TRUE))
    ) %>%
      mutate(across(c(max_cooks_d, mean_cooks_d, max_hat, max_abs_rstudent), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x), NA_real_, .x)))
  })
}

track_lm_participants <- function(df, dv_cols, predictor_col, predictor_baseline_col = NULL, outcome_family, analysis_label) {
  map_df(dv_cols, function(dv) {
    dv_rest2_col <- paste0(sub("^delta_", "", dv), "_rest2")
    cols <- c("NECOS_ID", "Group", "log_mean_MFD_scaled", predictor_col, dv, dv_rest2_col)
    if (!is.null(predictor_baseline_col)) cols <- c(cols, predictor_baseline_col)

    dat <- df %>%
      select(any_of(cols)) %>%
      mutate(
        dv_missing = is.na(.data[[dv]]),
        dv_baseline_missing = is.na(.data[[dv_rest2_col]]),
        pred_missing = is.na(.data[[predictor_col]]),
        predictor_baseline_missing = if (is.null(predictor_baseline_col)) FALSE else is.na(.data[[predictor_baseline_col]]),
        motion_missing = is.na(log_mean_MFD_scaled),
        group_missing = is.na(Group),
        included = !(dv_missing | dv_baseline_missing | pred_missing | predictor_baseline_missing | motion_missing | group_missing),
        exclusion_reason = case_when(
          included ~ "included",
          dv_missing ~ paste0("missing DV: ", dv),
          dv_baseline_missing ~ paste0("missing DV baseline: ", dv_rest2_col),
          pred_missing ~ paste0("missing predictor: ", predictor_col),
          predictor_baseline_missing ~ paste0("missing predictor baseline: ", predictor_baseline_col),
          motion_missing ~ "missing motion covariate: log_mean_MFD_scaled",
          group_missing ~ "missing group",
          TRUE ~ "other"
        )
      )

    dat %>%
      transmute(
        NECOS_ID,
        DV = dv,
        predictor = predictor_col,
        baseline = ifelse(is.null(predictor_baseline_col), NA_character_, predictor_baseline_col),
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        included,
        exclusion_reason
      )
  })
}

save_model_diagnostic_plots <- function(models, model_family, file_stub) {
  walk(names(models), function(nm) {
    mod <- models[[nm]]
    if (is.null(mod)) return(NULL)

    diag_df <- tibble(
      fitted = fitted(mod),
      residuals = resid(mod)
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(fitted), is.finite(residuals))

    if (nrow(diag_df) == 0) return(NULL)

    qq_plot <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(sample = residuals)) +
      stat_qq() +
      stat_qq_line() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste(model_family, nm, "residual QQ plot"),
        x = "Theoretical quantiles",
        y = "Sample quantiles"
      )

    resid_plot <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste(model_family, nm, "residuals vs fitted"),
        x = "Fitted values",
        y = "Residuals"
      )

    base_name <- paste0(sanitize_stub(file_stub), "_", sanitize_stub(nm))

    ggsave(file.path(diag_qq_dir, paste0(base_name, "_qq.png")), qq_plot, width = 6, height = 5)
    ggsave(file.path(diag_resid_dir, paste0(base_name, "_resid_fitted.png")), resid_plot, width = 6, height = 5)
  })
}

run_delta_lm_screen <- function(data, delta_dv_cols, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col = NULL, outcome_family, file_stub, analysis_label, sensitivity_exclude_ids = character(0)) {
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) == 0 || !(predictor_delta_col %in% names(data)) || any(!delta_dv_cols %in% names(data)) || (!is.null(predictor_baseline_col) && !(predictor_baseline_col %in% names(data)))) {
    message("Skipping ", analysis_label, " / ", predictor_delta_col, " because required data are not available.")
    return(list(models = set_names(vector("list", length(delta_dv_cols)), delta_dv_cols),
                results = tibble(), complete_cases = tibble(), vif = tibble(), tracking = tibble(),
                influence = tibble(), sensitivity_results = tibble()))
  }

  complete_cases <- map_df(delta_dv_cols, ~ count_complete_cases_lm(data, .x, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col))
  tracking <- track_lm_participants(data, delta_dv_cols, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col, outcome_family, analysis_label)

  fit_obj <- fit_lm_delta_set(data, delta_dv_cols, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col)
  models <- fit_obj$models
  fit_errors <- fit_obj$errors

  results <- extract_lm_term(
    models = models,
    fit_errors = fit_errors,
    term_label_model = paste0("Group:", predictor_delta_col),
    term_label_report = paste0("Group:", predictor_delta_col),
    predictor_label = predictor_delta_col,
    baseline_label = predictor_baseline_col,
    outcome_family = outcome_family,
    analysis_label = analysis_label,
    file_stub = file_stub
   ) %>%
    left_join(complete_cases, by = c("DV", "predictor", "baseline")) %>%
    arrange(p)

  vif_table <- extract_lm_vif(data, delta_dv_cols, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col, outcome_family)
  influence_table <- extract_lm_influence_summary(models, predictor_delta_col, outcome_family, analysis_label)

  sensitivity_results <- tibble()
  if (length(sensitivity_exclude_ids) > 0) {
    sens_fit <- fit_lm_delta_set(data %>% filter(!NECOS_ID %in% sensitivity_exclude_ids), delta_dv_cols, predictor_delta_col, predictor_baseline_col)
    sensitivity_results <- extract_lm_term(
      models = sens_fit$models,
      fit_errors = sens_fit$errors,
      term_label_model = paste0("Group:", predictor_delta_col),
      term_label_report = paste0("Group:", predictor_delta_col),
      predictor_label = predictor_delta_col,
      baseline_label = predictor_baseline_col,
      outcome_family = outcome_family,
      analysis_label = paste0(analysis_label, "_sensitivity"),
      file_stub = paste0(file_stub, "_sensitivity")
     ) %>%
      mutate(sensitivity_exclusion = paste(sensitivity_exclude_ids, collapse = ","))

    sens_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col, "_sensitivity_results.csv"))
    readr::write_csv(sensitivity_results, sens_path)
    write_output_metadata(
      sens_path,
      description = paste("Sensitivity results for", outcome_family, "excluding influential participants for predictor", predictor_delta_col),
      columns = list(
        DV = "Dependent variable.",
        predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
        sensitivity_exclusion = "Comma-separated IDs excluded in the sensitivity analysis.",
        p = "Uncorrected p-value for the interaction term."
      )
    )
  }

  results_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col, "_results.csv"))
  complete_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col, "_complete_cases.csv"))
  vif_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col, "_vif.csv"))
  tracking_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col, "_participant_tracking.csv"))
  influence_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col, "_influence.csv"))

  readr::write_csv(results, results_path)
  readr::write_csv(complete_cases, complete_path)
  readr::write_csv(vif_table, vif_path)
  readr::write_csv(tracking, tracking_path)
  readr::write_csv(influence_table, influence_path)

  write_output_metadata(
    results_path,
    description = paste("Model-level baseline-adjusted delta ANCOVA results for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_delta_col),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      term = "Statistical test label.",
      predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
      n = "Number of participants used in the fitted model.",
      baseline = "Baseline physiological covariate included in the model, if any.",
      p = "Uncorrected p-value for the Group by predictor interaction term in the baseline-adjusted delta ANCOVA."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    complete_path,
    description = paste("Complete-case counts for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_delta_col),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
      n_complete_rows = "Number of complete rows available.",
      n_complete_ids = "Number of unique participants with complete data."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    vif_path,
    description = paste("Variance inflation factors for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_delta_col),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      term = "Model term.",
      vif = "VIF or GVIF.",
      gvif_adj = "Adjusted GVIF when applicable.",
      baseline_vif_note = "The baseline DV term may show elevated collinearity because the delta outcome is defined relative to the same rest2 measurement; interpret this in context rather than as a standalone model failure."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    tracking_path,
    description = paste("Participant inclusion tracking for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_delta_col),
    columns = list(
      NECOS_ID = "Participant ID.",
      included = "Whether the participant contributed to the final model.",
      exclusion_reason = "Reason for exclusion if not included."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    influence_path,
    description = paste("Influence diagnostics for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_delta_col, ". These summaries are descriptive only and were not used to define the pre-specified sensitivity exclusions."),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
      n = "Number of observations used in the fitted model.",
      max_cooks_d = "Maximum Cook's distance across observations.",
      mean_cooks_d = "Mean Cook's distance across observations.",
      n_cooks_gt_4_over_n = "Count of observations with Cook's distance greater than 4/n.",
      max_hat = "Maximum leverage (hat) value.",
      max_abs_rstudent = "Maximum absolute studentized residual."
    )
  )

  save_model_diagnostic_plots(models, outcome_family, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_delta_col))

  list(models = models, results = results, complete_cases = complete_cases, vif = vif_table, tracking = tracking, influence = influence_table, sensitivity_results = sensitivity_results)
}

## Run optional random-intercept sensitivity LMMs

```{r}
count_complete_cases_lmm <- function(df, dv, predictor_col, baseline_col = NULL) {
  cols <- c("NECOS_ID", "Group", "scan", "log_MFD_scaled", predictor_col, dv)
  if (!is.null(baseline_col)) cols <- c(cols, baseline_col)

  dat <- df %>%
    select(any_of(cols)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    group_by(NECOS_ID) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(scan) == 2) %>%
    ungroup()

  tibble(
    DV = dv,
    predictor = predictor_col,
    n_complete_rows = nrow(dat),
    n_complete_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(dat$NECOS_ID)
  )
}

prepare_lmm_data <- function(df, dv, predictor_col, baseline_col = NULL) {
  cols <- c("NECOS_ID", "Group", "scan", "log_MFD_scaled", predictor_col, dv)
  if (!is.null(baseline_col)) cols <- c(cols, baseline_col)

  df %>%
    select(any_of(cols)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    group_by(NECOS_ID) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(scan) == 2) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Group = droplevels(Group),
      scan = droplevels(factor(scan, levels = c("rest2", "rest3")))
    )
}

get_lmm_convergence_message <- function(mod, fit_error = NA_character_) {
  if (is.null(mod)) return(fit_error)
  msgs <- mod@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  if (is.null(msgs)) "OK" else paste(msgs, collapse = " | ")
}

extract_lmm_r2 <- function(mod) {
  if (is.null(mod) || !requireNamespace("MuMIn", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(list(r2_marginal = NA_real_, r2_conditional = NA_real_))
  }

  r2_obj <- tryCatch(MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(mod), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r2_obj)) {
    return(list(r2_marginal = NA_real_, r2_conditional = NA_real_))
  }

  list(
    r2_marginal = as.numeric(r2_obj[1, 1]),
    r2_conditional = as.numeric(r2_obj[1, 2])
  )
}

extract_lmm_interaction_stats <- function(mod, predictor_col, require_scan = FALSE) {
  empty_out <- list(
    interaction_term = NA_character_,
    interaction_estimate = NA_real_,
    interaction_statistic = NA_real_,
    p_interaction_term = NA_real_
  )

  if (is.null(mod)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  tidy_fixef <- tryCatch(broom.mixed::tidy(mod, effects = "fixed"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(tidy_fixef) || !("term" %in% names(tidy_fixef))) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  has_target_interaction <- function(term, predictor_col, require_scan = FALSE) {
    comps <- unlist(strsplit(gsub("`", "", term), ":", fixed = TRUE))
    has_group <- any(grepl("^Group(\\d+)?$", comps))
    has_predictor <- predictor_col %in% comps
    has_scan <- any(grepl("^scan(\\d+)?$", comps))
    if (require_scan) {
      has_group && has_predictor && has_scan
    } else {
      has_group && has_predictor
    }
  }

  candidates <- tidy_fixef %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.keep_term = has_target_interaction(term, predictor_col, require_scan = require_scan)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(.keep_term) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(interaction_order = stringr::str_count(term, stringr::fixed(":"))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(interaction_order))

  if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  best <- candidates[1, ]

  list(
    interaction_term = best$term[[1]],
    interaction_estimate = if ("estimate" %in% names(best)) as.numeric(best$estimate[[1]]) else NA_real_,
    interaction_statistic = if ("statistic" %in% names(best)) as.numeric(best$statistic[[1]]) else NA_real_,
    p_interaction_term = if ("p.value" %in% names(best)) as.numeric(best$p.value[[1]]) else NA_real_
  )
}

fit_lmm_pair <- function(df, dv, predictor_col, baseline_col = NULL,
                         random_effect = "(1 | NECOS_ID)",
                         fixed_effect_spec = c("two_way", "three_way")) {
  fixed_effect_spec <- match.arg(fixed_effect_spec)
  dat <- prepare_lmm_data(df, dv, predictor_col, baseline_col)

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat$NECOS_ID) < 5) {
    return(list(full = NULL, null = NULL, data = dat, full_error = "Insufficient balanced data for LMM", null_error = "Insufficient balanced data for LMM"))
  }

  base_part <- if (!is.null(baseline_col)) paste0(" + ", baseline_col) else ""

  if (fixed_effect_spec == "three_way") {
    full_f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group * scan * ", predictor_col, base_part, " + log_MFD_scaled + ", random_effect))
    null_f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group + scan + ", predictor_col, " + Group:scan + Group:", predictor_col, " + scan:", predictor_col, base_part, " + log_MFD_scaled + ", random_effect))
  } else {
    full_f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group * ", predictor_col, " + scan", base_part, " + log_MFD_scaled + ", random_effect))
    null_f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group + ", predictor_col, " + scan", base_part, " + log_MFD_scaled + ", random_effect))
  }

  ctrl <- lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

  full_fit <- purrr::safely(function() lmerTest::lmer(full_f, data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), otherwise = NULL)()
  null_fit <- purrr::safely(function() lmerTest::lmer(null_f, data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), otherwise = NULL)()

  list(
    full = full_fit$result,
    null = null_fit$result,
    data = dat,
    full_error = if (is.null(full_fit$error)) NA_character_ else conditionMessage(full_fit$error),
    null_error = if (is.null(null_fit$error)) NA_character_ else conditionMessage(null_fit$error)
  )
}

fit_lmm_pairs <- function(df, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col = NULL,
                          random_effect = "(1 | NECOS_ID)",
                          fixed_effect_spec = c("two_way", "three_way")) {
  fixed_effect_spec <- match.arg(fixed_effect_spec)
  pairs <- map(dv_cols, ~ fit_lmm_pair(df, .x, predictor_col, baseline_col, random_effect = random_effect, fixed_effect_spec = fixed_effect_spec))
  names(pairs) <- dv_cols
  pairs
}

extract_lmm_term <- function(pairs, predictor_col, baseline_col, outcome_family, analysis_label, file_stub, fixed_effect_spec = c("two_way", "three_way")) {
  fixed_effect_spec <- match.arg(fixed_effect_spec)
  map_df(names(pairs), function(nm) {
    pair <- pairs[[nm]]
    full <- pair$full
    null <- pair$null
    dat <- pair$data

    if (is.null(full) || is.null(null)) {
      return(tibble(
        DV = nm,
        term = paste0("LRT_full_vs_null_", predictor_col),
        predictor = predictor_col,
        baseline = ifelse(is.null(baseline_col), NA_character_, baseline_col),
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        model_bundle = paste0(file_stub, "__", predictor_col),
        n = if (!is.null(dat)) nrow(dat) else NA_integer_,
        singular = NA,
        convergence = paste(na.omit(unique(c(pair$full_error, pair$null_error))), collapse = " | "),
        test = "likelihood_ratio_test",
        chisq = NA_real_,
        df_diff = NA_real_,
        eta2_partial = NA_real_,
        r2_marginal = NA_real_,
        r2_conditional = NA_real_,
        interaction_term = NA_character_,
        interaction_estimate = NA_real_,
        interaction_statistic = NA_real_,
        p_interaction_term = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    lrt <- tryCatch(anova(null, full), error = function(e) NULL)
    p_lrt <- if (!is.null(lrt) && "Pr(>Chisq)" %in% names(lrt)) as.numeric(lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]) else NA_real_
    chisq <- if (!is.null(lrt) && "Chisq" %in% names(lrt)) as.numeric(lrt$Chisq[2]) else NA_real_
    df_diff <- if (!is.null(lrt) && "Chi Df" %in% names(lrt)) as.numeric(lrt$`Chi Df`[2]) else if (!is.null(lrt) && "Df" %in% names(lrt)) as.numeric(diff(lrt$Df))[1] else NA_real_

    r2_out <- extract_lmm_r2(full)
    interaction_out <- extract_lmm_interaction_stats(full, predictor_col, require_scan = fixed_effect_spec == "three_way")

    tibble(
      DV = nm,
      term = paste0("LRT_full_vs_null_", predictor_col),
      predictor = predictor_col,
      baseline = ifelse(is.null(baseline_col), NA_character_, baseline_col),
      outcome_family = outcome_family,
      analysis = analysis_label,
      model_bundle = paste0(file_stub, "__", predictor_col),
      n = stats::nobs(full),
      singular = lme4::isSingular(full, tol = 1e-4),
      convergence = get_lmm_convergence_message(full, pair$full_error),
      test = "likelihood_ratio_test",
      chisq = chisq,
      df_diff = df_diff,
      eta2_partial = NA_real_,
      r2_marginal = r2_out$r2_marginal,
      r2_conditional = r2_out$r2_conditional,
      interaction_term = interaction_out$interaction_term,
      interaction_estimate = interaction_out$interaction_estimate,
      interaction_statistic = interaction_out$interaction_statistic,
      p_interaction_term = interaction_out$p_interaction_term,
      p = p_lrt
    )
  })
}

extract_lmm_vif <- function(df, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col, outcome_family) {
  map_df(dv_cols, function(dv) {
    dat <- prepare_lmm_data(df, dv, predictor_col, baseline_col)
    if (nrow(dat) < 10 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat$NECOS_ID) < 5) {
      return(extract_vif_table(NULL, dv, predictor_col, outcome_family))
    }

    base_part <- if (!is.null(baseline_col)) paste0(" + ", baseline_col) else ""
    lm_proxy <- tryCatch(
      stats::lm(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Group * ", predictor_col, " + scan", base_part, " + log_MFD_scaled")), data = dat),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    vif_obj <- tryCatch(car::vif(lm_proxy, type = "predictor"), error = function(e) NULL)
    extract_vif_table(vif_obj, dv, predictor_col, outcome_family)
  })
}

track_lmm_participants <- function(df, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col = NULL, outcome_family, analysis_label) {
  map_df(dv_cols, function(dv) {
    cols <- c("NECOS_ID", "Group", "scan", "log_MFD_scaled", predictor_col, dv)
    if (!is.null(baseline_col)) cols <- c(cols, baseline_col)

    dat <- df %>% select(any_of(cols))

    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(
        dv_missing = is.na(.data[[dv]]),
        pred_missing = is.na(.data[[predictor_col]]),
        motion_missing = is.na(log_MFD_scaled),
        baseline_missing = if (is.null(baseline_col)) FALSE else is.na(.data[[baseline_col]]),
        group_missing = is.na(Group),
        scan_missing = is.na(scan),
        row_complete = !(dv_missing | pred_missing | motion_missing | baseline_missing | group_missing | scan_missing),
        row_exclusion_reason = case_when(
          row_complete ~ "included",
          dv_missing ~ paste0("missing DV: ", dv),
          pred_missing ~ paste0("missing predictor: ", predictor_col),
          baseline_missing ~ paste0("missing baseline: ", baseline_col),
          motion_missing ~ "missing motion covariate: log_MFD_scaled",
          group_missing ~ "missing group",
          scan_missing ~ "missing scan",
          TRUE ~ "other"
        )
      )

    dat %>%
      group_by(NECOS_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        DV = dv,
        predictor = predictor_col,
        baseline = ifelse(is.null(baseline_col), NA_character_, baseline_col),
        outcome_family = outcome_family,
        analysis = analysis_label,
        n_rows_total = n(),
        n_rows_complete = sum(row_complete),
        n_complete_scans = n_distinct(scan[row_complete]),
        complete_scans = paste(sort(unique(as.character(scan[row_complete]))), collapse = ","),
        included = n_complete_scans == 2,
        exclusion_reason = case_when(
          included ~ "included",
          n_rows_complete == 0 ~ paste(sort(unique(row_exclusion_reason[!row_complete])), collapse = "; "),
          n_complete_scans < 2 ~ "not complete at both scans",
          TRUE ~ "other"
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
}

run_lmm_screen <- function(data, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col = NULL, outcome_family, file_stub, analysis_label,
                           random_effect = "(1 | NECOS_ID)", fixed_effect_spec = c("two_way", "three_way")) {
  fixed_effect_spec <- match.arg(fixed_effect_spec)
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) == 0 || !(predictor_col %in% names(data)) || any(!dv_cols %in% names(data)) || (!is.null(baseline_col) && !(baseline_col %in% names(data)))) {
    message("Skipping ", analysis_label, " / ", predictor_col, " because required data are not available.")
    return(list(models = set_names(vector("list", length(dv_cols)), dv_cols),
                pairs = set_names(vector("list", length(dv_cols)), dv_cols),
                results = tibble(), complete_cases = tibble(), vif = tibble(), tracking = tibble()))
  }

  complete_cases <- map_df(dv_cols, ~ count_complete_cases_lmm(data, .x, predictor_col, baseline_col))
  tracking <- track_lmm_participants(data, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col, outcome_family, analysis_label)

  pairs <- fit_lmm_pairs(data, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col, random_effect = random_effect, fixed_effect_spec = fixed_effect_spec)
  full_models <- map(pairs, "full")
  names(full_models) <- dv_cols

  results <- extract_lmm_term(
    pairs = pairs,
    predictor_col = predictor_col,
    baseline_col = baseline_col,
    outcome_family = outcome_family,
    analysis_label = analysis_label,
    file_stub = file_stub,
    fixed_effect_spec = fixed_effect_spec
  ) %>%
    left_join(complete_cases, by = c("DV", "predictor")) %>%
    mutate(random_effect = random_effect) %>%
    arrange(p)

  vif_table <- extract_lmm_vif(data, dv_cols, predictor_col, baseline_col, outcome_family)

  results_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_col, "_results.csv"))
  complete_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_col, "_complete_cases.csv"))
  vif_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_col, "_vif.csv"))
  tracking_path <- file.path(models_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_col, "_participant_tracking.csv"))

  readr::write_csv(results, results_path)
  readr::write_csv(complete_cases, complete_path)
  readr::write_csv(vif_table, vif_path)
  readr::write_csv(tracking, tracking_path)

  write_output_metadata(
    results_path,
    description = paste("Model-level results for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_col, ". For LRT-based LMMs, eta2_partial is not reported because the primary omnibus test is a likelihood-ratio chi-square test rather than an F-test; use r2_marginal and r2_conditional as the reported effect-size summaries instead."),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      term = "Statistical test label.",
      predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
      baseline = "Baseline covariate included in the model, if any.",
      outcome_family = "Analysis family.",
      analysis = "Analysis label.",
      n = "Number of rows used in the fitted model.",
      singular = "Whether the mixed model fit was singular.",
      convergence = "Convergence message or fit error.",
      p = "Uncorrected omnibus LRT p-value.",
      interaction_term = "Specific fixed-effect interaction term corresponding to the predictor of interest.",
      p_interaction_term = "P-value for the specific Group × predictor interaction term from the coefficient table."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    complete_path,
    description = paste("Complete-case counts for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_col),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
      n_complete_rows = "Number of complete rows available.",
      n_complete_ids = "Number of unique participants with complete data."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    vif_path,
    description = paste("Variance inflation factors for proxy fixed-effect models in", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_col),
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      term = "Model term.",
      vif = "VIF or GVIF.",
      gvif_adj = "Adjusted GVIF when applicable."
    )
  )
  write_output_metadata(
    tracking_path,
    description = paste("Participant inclusion tracking for", outcome_family, "using predictor", predictor_col),
    columns = list(
      NECOS_ID = "Participant ID.",
      included = "Whether the participant contributed to the final model.",
      exclusion_reason = "Reason for exclusion if not included."
    )
  )

  save_model_diagnostic_plots(full_models, outcome_family, paste0(file_stub, "_", predictor_col))

  list(models = full_models, pairs = pairs, results = results, complete_cases = complete_cases, vif = vif_table, tracking = tracking)
}

if (run_random_intercept_sensitivity) {
  rs_specs <- list(
    list(data = ecc_hr_data, dv = ecc_dv_cols, pred = "HR_delta", fam = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "ecc_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = ecc_hrv_data, dv = ecc_dv_cols, pred = "HRV_delta", fam = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "ecc_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = ecc_saliva_data, dv = ecc_dv_cols, pred = "SaCort_delta", fam = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "ecc_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = ecc_acth_data, dv = ecc_dv_cols, pred = "asinh_ACTH_delta", fam = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "ecc_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = ecc_stai_data, dv = ecc_dv_cols, pred = "STAI_delta", fam = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "ecc_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = ecc_vas_data, dv = ecc_dv_cols, pred = "VAS_delta", fam = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "eccentricity_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "ecc_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = disp_hr_data, dv = disp_dv_cols, pred = "HR_delta", fam = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "disp_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = disp_hrv_data, dv = disp_dv_cols, pred = "HRV_delta", fam = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "disp_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = disp_saliva_data, dv = disp_dv_cols, pred = "SaCort_delta", fam = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "disp_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = disp_acth_data, dv = disp_dv_cols, pred = "asinh_ACTH_delta", fam = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "disp_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = disp_stai_data, dv = disp_dv_cols, pred = "STAI_delta", fam = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "disp_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity"),
    list(data = disp_vas_data, dv = disp_dv_cols, pred = "VAS_delta", fam = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", stub = "dispersion_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity", lab = "disp_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity")
  )

  rs_results <- map(rs_specs, function(sp) {
    run_lmm_screen(
      sp$data,
      sp$dv,
      sp$pred,
      outcome_family = sp$fam,
      file_stub = sp$stub,
      analysis_label = sp$lab,
      random_effect = "(1 | NECOS_ID)",
      fixed_effect_spec = "three_way"
    )
  })

  lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity_results_all <- bind_rows(map(rs_results, "results"))
  lmm_random_intercept_path <- file.path(models_dir, "peripheral_lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity_results.csv")
  readr::write_csv(lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity_results_all, lmm_random_intercept_path)
  write_output_metadata(
    lmm_random_intercept_path,
    description = "Three-way random-intercept LMM robustness checks using participant-level baseline-normalized peak-reactivity predictors only. Descriptive physiology plots elsewhere in the script show scan-level rest2/rest3 trajectories for illustration and are not the predictors entered into these models. These models are excluded from all multiple-comparison correction pools and are reported as supplementary, uncorrected sensitivity analyses. For these LRT-based mixed models, eta2_partial is not reported; use r2_marginal and r2_conditional as the effect-size summaries.",
    columns = list(
      DV = "Dependent variable.",
      predictor = "Predictor used in the robustness model.",
      p = "Uncorrected model-level likelihood-ratio-test p-value for the robustness model.",
      p_interaction_term = "Uncorrected coefficient-table p-value for the highest-order Group × scan × predictor term in the robustness model, retained for interpretation only."
    )
  )
} else {
  message("Random-intercept sensitivity models skipped because run_random_intercept_sensitivity is FALSE.")
}

all_results <- bind_rows(

      str_detect(outcome_family, "dispersion") ~ "dispersion",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    p_primary = p,

  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(

    p_holm_global = p.adjust(p_primary, method = "holm")

Multiple-comparison correction uses delta-ANCOVA model-level p-values and is applied within the eccentricity family and within the dispersion family, with an additional global BH correction across both families combined. The primary ANCOVA estimand is a baseline-conditional change parameterization: the delta outcome is modeled together with the baseline value of the same outcome to reduce regression-to-the-mean artefacts, and is therefore a baseline-adjusted association with change rather than an unadjusted raw-difference effect. Two-way LMMs are no longer part of this primary results table or its correction workflow. Three-way random-slope LMMs are reported separately as lower-power, uncorrected sensitivity analyses and are excluded from all correction pools. Delta-model influence summaries are reported separately in peripheral_delta_influence.csv.",

Two-way LMMs are excluded from these counts, and three-way random-slope LMM robustness checks are reported separately without correction.",
  columns = list(
    construct_family = "Construct family (eccentricity or dispersion).",
    outcome_family = "Specific primary analysis family.",
    predictor = "Predictor used in the model family.",
    n_tests_omnibus = "Number of primary ANCOVA tests with a non-missing model-level p-value.",
    n_tests_primary = "Number of tests contributing a non-missing p_primary value to the correction step.",
    n_fdr_within_family_sig = "Number surviving within-family FDR.",
    n_holm_within_family_sig = "Number surviving within-family Holm correction.",
    n_fdr_global_sig = "Number surviving global FDR.",
    n_holm_global_sig = "Number surviving global Holm correction."
  )
)

write_output_metadata(
  tracking_path,
  description = "Participant-level inclusion tracking across primary delta ANCOVA analyses.",
  columns = list(
    NECOS_ID = "Participant ID.",
    DV = "Dependent variable.",
    predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
    analysis = "Analysis label.",
    included = "Whether the participant contributed to the final model.",
    exclusion_reason = "Reason for exclusion if not included."
  )
)

write_output_metadata(
  delta_influence_path,
  description = "Combined influence diagnostics across all baseline-adjusted delta ANCOVA models. These summaries are descriptive only and were not used to define the pre-specified sensitivity exclusions.",
  columns = list(
    DV = "Dependent variable.",
    predictor = "Predictor used in the model.",
    outcome_family = "Analysis family label.",
    analysis = "Analysis label.",
    n = "Number of observations used in the fitted model.",
    max_cooks_d = "Maximum Cook's distance across observations.",
    mean_cooks_d = "Mean Cook's distance across observations.",
    n_cooks_gt_4_over_n = "Count of observations with Cook's distance greater than 4/n.",
    max_hat = "Maximum leverage (hat) value.",
    max_abs_rstudent = "Maximum absolute studentized residual."
  )
)

message("Two-way LMMs are excluded from the primary results summary and no LMM post-hoc emtrends were run in this version.")

manifest_entries <- list(
  peripheral_model_results = list(path = basename(all_results_path), purpose = "Primary baseline-adjusted delta ANCOVA results table with within-family and global correction."),
  peripheral_model_result_counts = list(path = basename(counts_path), purpose = "Counts of primary ANCOVA tests and discoveries under each correction scheme."),
  peripheral_participant_tracking = list(path = basename(tracking_path), purpose = "Participant inclusion/exclusion tracking across primary delta ANCOVA analyses."),
  peripheral_delta_influence = list(path = basename(delta_influence_path), purpose = "Descriptive influence diagnostics across all baseline-adjusted delta ANCOVA models.")
)
if (exists("lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity_results_all") && nrow(lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity_results_all) > 0) {
  manifest_entries$lmm_random_intercept_sensitivity_results <- list(path = basename(lmm_random_intercept_path), purpose = "Three-way random-intercept LMM robustness checks with participant-level stress-reactivity predictors reported without multiple-comparison correction.")
}
write_metadata_manifest(manifest_entries, manifest_path)
```

Descriptive, two-panel, dual-axis, and spaghetti plot sections are removed from the published peripheral workflow.
